title: StrategyPackage mutable configuration versioning is incomplete and not connected to Paper v2/Selection runtime
description:
Expected: StrategyPackage should keep the initial QE backtest-derived package version frozen, while any non-core runtime/configuration changes after packaging must create a new auditable StrategyPackage version or validated runtime variant. Operators should be able to create a new version/variant for strategy_config, portfolio_policy/top_k, execution_policy, minute_execution_policy, ordinary risk/tradability/blacklist settings, and Selection Center/Paper v2 should explicitly consume the selected version/variant. HMM and ST PIT are platform functions and must not be represented as StrategyPackage-bound variants or package contract fields at all.
Actual: runtime_variant.py defines STRATEGY_CONFIG, EXECUTION_POLICY, RISK_POLICY, HMM_OVERLAY, and COMBINED variants and router APIs expose create/list/mark-validation operations, but read-only scan found no Paper v2/Selection Center runtime path that accepts or consumes runtime_variant_id/paper_candidate when running selection or paper portfolios. Existing normalization still applies the frozen QE backtest contract from the initial manifest instead of a selected mutable package version/variant. The existing HMM_OVERLAY/hmm_overlay variant kind is also invalid because HMM must be provided by the platform runtime and never bound to StrategyPackage.
reproduce_command: rg -n "runtime_variant_id|paper_candidate|RuntimeVariantKind|HMM_OVERLAY|hmm_overlay|create_runtime_variant|mark_runtime_variant_validation|normalize_runtime_config_with_backtest_contract" backend/services/strategy_package backend/routers/strategy_packages.py backend/services/paper_trading_v2 backend/services/selection_center frontend/src/app/paper-v2 backend/tests -S
required_verification: Selection Center and Paper v2 can select and run a non-HMM/ST-PIT config version/variant different from the initial package while preserving full version history.
Tests fail if HMM_OVERLAY/hmm_overlay or any ST PIT snapshot/risk snapshot can be saved as a StrategyPackage-bound variant.
runtime_variant_id/paper_candidate or the replacement versioning mechanism is actually wired into Selection Center and Paper v2, not just exposed as unused CRUD APIs.
The initial QE package version remains immutable and auditable after each later config change.
closure_requirements: Every permitted non-core config change creates a traceable package version/variant/hash/activation.
No StrategyPackage or runtime variant schema admits HMM or ST PIT as bound package state.
Selection Center and Paper v2 consume the selected version/variant and persist which version drove each run.

events.note: Registered by Codex App from Paper v2 StrategyPackage/HMM/ST PIT read-only audit; no runtime code changed.

Business impact: P0 because Paper v2 operators cannot safely evolve package configuration after QE packaging; they either mutate runtime intent without durable package history or are blocked by the frozen initial backtest contract.
Hard boundary: StrategyPackage core binding is factors plus trained strategy model; HMM/ST PIT are platform-only and must be removed from package/variant semantics entirely.
